feature: an ADR is compiled to a spec, the spec to sealed tests
description: ADR-2610221540 stated as behaviour. Scenarios without a test are phases 3 and 4: drafting from the ADR and ports alone, red-first generation, sealing inside build and do, and --prove.

specs.description: A spec that gives every decision an example and a negative is covered
specs.given: an ADR with §1 and §2, and a spec with an example and a negative citing each
specs.then: it exits 0

specs.description: A scenario may not cite a decision the ADR does not make
specs.given: an ADR with one decision and a scenario citing §7
specs.then: it fails and names §7

specs.description: A binding ADR made under this decision must have a spec
specs.given: an Accepted ADR dated after ADR-2610221540 with no docs/specs file
specs.when: `hexa spec check` runs over the ledger
specs.then: it fails, naming the ADR and 'no spec'

specs.description: The spec author is given the ADR and the port signatures it names
specs.given: an ADR naming a port, and an implementation of that port in the tree
specs.when: `hexa spec draft <ADR>` builds the author's prompt
specs.then: the prompt holds the ADR text and the port signatures

specs.description: The spec author never sees the implementation
specs.given: an implementation file containing a unique marker string
specs.when: `hexa spec draft <ADR>` builds the author's prompt
specs.then: the marker is absent from everything sent to the model

specs.description: A decision no scenario cites is named as uncovered
specs.given: a spec citing only §1 of a two-decision ADR
specs.then: it fails and names §2 as uncovered

specs.description: A decision with an example and no negative is half a rule
specs.given: a spec with only an example for §1
specs.then: it fails, naming §1 and 'negative'

specs.description: A universal decision needs a property scenario
specs.given: a spec declaring §1 universal, with an example and a negative
specs.then: it fails, asking for a property

specs.description: An exemption with a reason covers its decision and is printed every run
specs.given: §2 exempted because it names a file layout
specs.then: it exits 0 and prints the exemption and its reason

specs.description: An exemption without a reason is refused
specs.given: §2 exempted with a blank reason
specs.then: it fails, naming §2 and the missing reason

specs.description: An accepted, sealed spec whose tests pass verifies
specs.given: a covered spec, accepted by a person and sealed
specs.then: every scenario passes alone and it exits 0

specs.description: Tests are never sealed against a spec nobody accepted
specs.given: a covered spec with no acceptance
specs.then: it refuses and says the spec is not accepted

specs.description: A spec changed after acceptance no longer verifies
specs.given: an accepted, sealed spec whose `then` is then edited
specs.then: it fails, saying the spec changed since it was accepted

specs.description: Generated tests are red before the implementation and the red commit is recorded
specs.given: an accepted spec and an unimplemented port
specs.when: `hexa spec tests <ADR>` generates and runs the tests
specs.then: every test compiles and fails, and the commit is written as `red`

specs.description: A generated test that passes before any implementation is rejected
specs.given: a generated test that asserts nothing about the port
specs.when: `hexa spec tests` runs it against the unimplemented port
specs.then: the test is rejected as testing nothing

specs.description: A sealed test edited by hand fails verification
specs.given: an accepted, sealed spec whose test file is then edited
specs.then: it fails, naming the file and the broken seal

specs.description: The code agent cannot write a sealed test
specs.given: `hexa do run --spec <ADR>` whose agent edits a sealed test file
specs.then: the run fails and commits nothing

specs.description: A requirement changes through the ADR, then the spec, then a new acceptance and seal
specs.given: an accepted, sealed spec whose behaviour is revised and accepted again, and its tests resealed
specs.then: it passes

specs.description: A failing test fails verification
specs.given: a scenario whose test panics
specs.then: it fails, naming the scenario as failed

specs.description: A test ref to a function that is not there fails
specs.given: a scenario naming a missing function
specs.then: it fails, naming the function as not found

specs.description: A test that runs zero cases is vacuous
specs.given: a scenario naming a function compiled out of the test binary
specs.then: it fails as vacuous

specs.description: A skip is not a pass
specs.given: a scenario whose test refuses to skip under HEXA_NO_SKIP
specs.then: it is reported not proven here, and fails under --ci

specs.description: A scenario with no test yet is pending, and a Completed ADR may not have one
specs.given: an Accepted ADR's spec with one untested scenario, then the ADR marked Completed
specs.then: pending passes while Accepted and fails once Completed

specs.description: A test green at its red commit is a mirror
specs.given: a scenario whose `red` commit already has the test passing
specs.then: it fails, reporting the test as a mirror

specs.description: A `**Gate:**` line is a recorded gate
specs.given: an ADR whose gate is written `**Gate:** `true``
specs.then: the gate is found and passes

specs.description: A listed gate runs every command, not only the first
specs.given: a `**Gates**` list of `true` and `false`
specs.then: it fails

specs.description: A commit id beside a gate is not the gate
specs.given: a gate line citing `19b3487` before its listed commands
specs.then: the commands run, not the commit id

specs.description: A stale gate is re-recorded below the old one
specs.given: an ADR with `## Gate` `false` and an appended `## Gate (re-recorded …)` `true`
specs.then: the appended gate is the current one

specs.description: The legacy ledger only shrinks
specs.given: this repository's ledger
specs.when: `hexa spec check` and `hexa adr gates --dry-run` run
specs.then: the counts of ADRs without a spec, and without a gate, do not exceed their ceilings

specs.description: Every test that can skip refuses to under HEXA_NO_SKIP
specs.given: every tests/ file in the workspace
specs.then: each routes through one helper that panics 'not proven here' under HEXA_NO_SKIP
